description:
Cast Storm King's Thunder by paying {9}{R}{R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast nine times.
Cast Vraska's Fall by paying {2}{B}.
Storm King's Thunder triggers, copying Vraska's Fall nine times.
Resolve each Vraska's Fall, causing each opponent to get ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.
